blocks.text: You can connect your Zendesk organization to Advanced SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) to continuously monitor and correct Software as a Service (SaaS) security posture and ensure regulatory compliance is maintained across the organization.
A user with Admin privileges is required to connect Advanced SSPM to your Zendesk organization.
To connect your Zendesk organization to Advanced SSPM:

blocks.item: Click Connect in the upper-right corner of the SaaS Dashboard.
From the drop-down menu, select Zendesk.
In the Add Integration window, enter the Zendesk subdomain (e.g., if your Zendesk URL is my-company.zendesk.com, then enter my-company).
Go to the API tokens admin page at https://{your-subdomain}.zendesk.com/admin/apps-integrations/apis/api-tokens.
Enter a description for the token.
Click Save to generate the token.
Back in the Add Integration window, paste the newly generated API token under API token.
Enter the email address of the Zendesk admin who generated the token under API token owner email.
Click Connect to complete the integration.

blocks.text: Your Zendesk organization is now connected. After integration is completed, a success message appears, and the tenant details are updated on the Settings page.
